inv.desc_es:
Atractivo Local para reformar en Fuencarral -El Pardo.

Se ofrece magnífico local de 3 plantas, ubicado en la calle Avda. Betanzos, en el consolidado barrio de Fuencarral – El Pardo. Local para reformar íntegramente, cuidando cada detalle para ofrecer un espacio funcional, actual y acogedor.

Cuenta con una superficie de 68 m², exterior perfectamente aprovechados. Dispone además de 2 baños completos.

El local dispone de aire acondicionado con bomba de frío-calor, asegurando confort durante todo el año.
Ubicación Inmejorable. Situado en una de las zonas más comerciales del barrio, como el C. C. La Vaguada y a menos de 10 minutos del metro Peñagrande (L-7). Con acceso inmediato a importantes vías como la M-30 y M-40, así como las arterias principales de la ciudad.

Una oportunidad ideal para quienes buscan un espacio moderno, eficiente y bien comunicado.
No dejes pasar esta oportunidad de adquirir un local con infinitas posibilidades en una ubicación estratégica.

inv.desc_en:
Attractive premises for renovation in Fuencarral - El Pardo.

A magnificent 3-story property is offered, located on Avda. Betanzos, in the well-established neighborhood of Fuencarral – El Pardo. The premises are to be completely renovated, taking care of every detail to offer a functional, modern, and welcoming space.

It has an area of 68 m², exterior and perfectly utilized. It also has 2 full bathrooms.

The premises have air conditioning with a heat pump, ensuring comfort throughout the year.

Unbeatable location. Situated in one of the most commercial areas of the neighborhood, such as the La Vaguada Shopping Center, and less than 10 minutes from the Peñagrande metro station (L-7). With immediate access to major roads such as the M-30 and M-40, as well as the city's main arteries.

An ideal opportunity for those looking for a modern, efficient, and well-connected space.
Do not miss this opportunity to acquire a property with infinite possibilities in a strategic location.

Contact us for more information or to schedule a visit!

Grupo Mejocasa is a consolidated company in the real estate sector with more than 28 years of experience. We have four offices strategically located in Madrid with our own structure, which allows us to offer a proximity model with deep knowledge of the city.

We differentiate ourselves by offering a Comprehensive Real Estate Service based on Excellence and Commitment, with complete and personalized advice. We accompany you from beginning to end, taking care of the entire process for your total peace of mind.

Contact us and discover real estate management that meets your expectations.
